method: Compact source ingredient facts and paraphrased execution facts. Required quantities remain source quantities; optional additions are omitted only where source explicitly permits omission. No new FoodIngredient, source image, branding or production runtime change. Binary/HTML artifact hashes are owned by the orchestrator and must be attached before final provenance acceptance.
rights_basis: Apply the accepted source-specific direct-FNS project risk posture, not a public-domain or unrestricted commercial/derivative license assertion. Preserve actual source and contributor credits. Reviewed FNS recipe pages do not display a third-party copyright/licensing restriction; this absence is not itself a statutory public-domain determination. Nutrition.gov-only candidates retain a pending original-FNS-source review until the actual link is resolved. No photographs, logos or trademarks are imported.

mapping_notes: LEMON represents juice prepared from lemon; preserve 1 tablespoon of juice, with no invented whole-fruit count or mass conversion.

Dice fruit and vegetables and combine with dressing.

Serve chilled; source says best served within 24 hours.

ingredient_facts: garlic minced: 1 clove OR garlic powder: 1/4 teaspoon
cauliflower medium, grated or finely chopped: 1 (4 to 5 cups)
lemon or lime juice: 1 tablespoon, optional
fresh parsley or cilantro chopped: 2 tablespoons, optional
mapping_notes: Source-generic vegetable oil resolves to existing sunflower oil; source-generic bulb onion to yellow onion. Explicit fresh garlic alternative selected. Optional citrus and herbs omitted. Cauliflower is a whole medium head grated during preparation, NOT a required bag of retail cauliflower rice.

MyPlate actual Source link opened successfully through Nutrition.gov during this review; full primary page preserved exact optional alternatives. Nutrition.gov corroborates identical six selected required rows but lists only optional lemon/parsley.
direction_facts: Wash hands.
Heat oil in large skillet or saucepan at medium heat; cook onion 3 to 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, cauliflower, salt and pepper; stir for 3 to 5 minutes until tender.
Omit explicitly optional finishing citrus/herbs; serve warm.
candidates.equipment_notes: Skillet selected from explicit skillet/saucepan alternative; grating/finely chopping are alternatives but a grater is not expressly named as equipment.
candidates.notices_reviewed: Full 386-line primary MyPlate page reviewed, including source and footer: Food Hero/OSU acknowledgment, no third-party copyright/licensing notice attached to the recipe. No Food Hero imagery or expressive marketing prose imported. Independent recipe, not an ICN card under a new title.

mapping_notes: Source specifies sweet onion but no color/cultivar. Choose sweet red Yalta onion as an existing ONION_RED member; do not claim all red/yellow onions are sweet. Retail audit independently identified purple-red sweet Yalta bulbs.
Preserve NEW/young potato purchase descriptor and tiny tuber selection; do not collapse young potatoes into arbitrary mature potatoes. Preserve three tubers, no invented mass.

Explicit green-bean alternative selected. WATER included as a quantified conditional preparation row, not silently dropped; retain source range 1–2 tablespoons and browning condition, do not turn into a required fixed 2 tablespoons.
direction_facts: Heat oil in skillet; cook onion 2 minutes, then garlic 1 minute.
Add potatoes and carrots; cover, reduce heat and cook about 4 minutes.
Only if browning begins, add 1 or 2 tablespoons water.
Add asparagus, selected green beans, radishes, salt, pepper and dill; stir and cook about 4 minutes until just tender.
Serve immediately.
candidates.equipment_notes: Skillet is explicit; cover operation requires its lid but source does not name a separate equipment noun. Do not add inferred knife or cutting board.

time_facts.note: Four source stage durations preserved; no independent source total duration stated.

Market source pages are evidence only, not production retailer integration.
